tools.name: plan_ladder
tools.description: For a wallet that already holds the assets it brings; from ETH or USDG, plan_build does the whole thing in one transaction. A ladder is one deposit spread over up to 40 narrow one-sided ranges ('rungs') of a Uniswap v3 or v4 pool: rungs under the price hold the quote asset (ETH, WETH, USDG or LOOM)

tools.name: plan_limit_order
tools.description: An order at a price: a limit sell holds the token in rungs over the price and sells it as the price rises through them; a limit buy holds the quote under the price and buys as it falls. tools.name: plan_ladder_action
tools.description: The unsigned transaction for one of a ladder's exits, or for a limit order's rule. collect: pays the fees earned and leaves the ladder working. close_part: takes sharePct of every rung out, the rest keeps working. close: pays the fees and returns everything; it is also how a limit order is cancelled
